title: FFT AI — Spine Connector v1.33
description: Manages live connection to the TriadicFrameworks Spine. Enforces INV-011: Spine URL must be resolved at runtime, never from cache.

resolution_protocol.trigger: session boot step 5 and any module requesting Spine reference
resolution_protocol.on_cache_hit: reject cache; force live fetch; log INV-011 compliance event
resolution_protocol.on_failure: Log WARN. Retry 3x with 5s timeout each. If all retries fail: set spine_state=degraded. Proceed on last-known-good reference ONLY. spine_state=degraded is NOT equivalent to INV-011 compliance. PX-007 (Spine Cache Drift) fires if any downstream module treats degraded as compliant.

live.description: Spine URL resolved successfully in this session

degraded.description: Live resolution failed after 3 retries. Proceeding on last-known-good.
degraded.inv_011: NOT satisfied — degraded is a named fallback, not compliance
degraded.px_risk: PX-007 fires if a downstream module treats degraded as a live resolution
degraded.required_action: Flag session for review. Do not promote degraded to live without a new successful resolution.
